# Contributing

The full contributor guide lives on the documentation site:

<https://mgovedarov.github.io/mcp-vcf-orchestrator/operations/contributing>

It covers the development commands, the `npm run validate` gate, adding tools,
adding resources and prompts, artifact work, dependency overrides, GitHub
Actions, the changelog convention and the `VCFO-###` issue codes.

This file is a pointer rather than a copy, so the two cannot drift. GitHub only
surfaces a contributing guide from `CONTRIBUTING.md` at the repository root, in
`.github/`, or in `docs/` — not from a nested path such as
`docs/operations/contributing.md`, which is where the guide itself lives.

Security issues follow a different path — see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
